journey.name: Draft without a MAC opens the Network page
journey.description: A draft that asks for a MAC-pinned NIC but gives no MAC opens on the Network page, so the user types the MAC instead of the assistant inventing one.

actions.action: If an "Allow write notifications?" dialog is shown, tap "Not now"
Verify that the Configuration card shows the "Network" page, not "Review"
Verify that a "Management NIC MAC" field is shown and is empty
